svg.title: Workshop learning flow
svg.desc: Labs 0–1 manually create the resource group, load the custom template, validate bootstrap, and download the private ZIP. Labs 2–6 develop one Prompt Agent in Foundry Portal. Lab 7 prepares Azure ML and compares plain and Harness Agents. Lab 8 deploys a source-based intake, policy, reviewer workflow. Lab 9 exports results, removes Hosted Agents and Compute, and deletes the resource group.
svg.text: Learning flow — one Prompt Agent, then reusable code
10 Labs · synthetic data only · no real booking, approval, or payment

text.tspan: Lab 0: overview and safety
1. Resource groups > Create: manually create ONE dedicated RG
2. Deploy a custom template > Build your own template in the editor > Load file
3. infra/azuredeploy.json > existing RG > Review + create > Create
4. Deployment Scripts validation passes > private ZIP download via Microsoft Entra user account
5. PC extract: Microsoft-Foundry-Agent-Service-Handson

svg.text: No Compute until Lab 7. Context = resource_outputs.<key>.value. Private container = workshop-files.

text.tspan: Lab 2 — Prompt Agent + direct Search
Create contoso-travel-assistant; Luna 40K TPM
Lab 3 — Foundry IQ
Two indexes; gpt-5.5; reuse the same remote knowledge base
Lab 4 — Toolbox / OpenAPI / Skills
Live portal-assets; Publish; Tool Search
Lab 5 — Evaluation
Seven synthetic rows; gpt-5.5 judge; inspect reasons / traces
Lab 6 — Agent Optimizer
Compare baseline + one candidate; gpt-5.5; promote only if better
Lab 7 preparation: Standard_DS3_v2 + Idle shutdown
Notebooks > User files > Upload folder
00-azureml-setup.ipynb: Python 3.10 - SDK v2
Creates Python (Foundry Workshop) + Python (Foundry Hosted Agent)
Lab 7 — plain Agent > Harness Agent
Foundry IQ + Toolbox + Skills; plan / todos / execute
Lab 8 — Hosted Agent source remote build
intake_agent > policy_agent > reviewer_agent
Reuses Foundry IQ; no Lab 7 session state

svg.text: Lab 9 — trace comparison and complete cleanup

text.tspan: Export notebooks > delete Hosted Agent / versions > Compute Stop / Delete
Azure Portal > Delete resource group > verify deletion
Delete the dedicated RG with its resources; deployment history deletion is not resource deletion

svg.text: Portal E2E must use actual UI; diagrams and simulated assets are not execution evidence.
